info.title: LeadFlow AI
info.description:
AI-powered lead management & workflow automation backend.

Public: `POST /api/enquiries`, `POST /api/auth/login`. Everything else needs a Bearer token (use the **Authorize** button after logging in).

post.description: PUBLIC. Saves the original enquiry, auto-assigns it to a team member, then runs the AI workflow in the background.

post.description: Run the automatic assignment rules again (e.g. after adding team members).
Retry AI processing (e.g. after a failure). Safe to repeat: records are updated, never duplicated.
Email the reply to the customer over SMTP (the edited reply if there is one). 409 if SMTP is not configured.
Prepare a WhatsApp click-to-chat link with the reply pre-filled and log it. The admin presses send in WhatsApp.
